name: Lens
subtitle: Lens camera builds
description: Builds of the Lens camera app.

apps.name: Lens
apps.subtitle: Native iPhone camera
apps.localizedDescription: Native iPhone camera with PNG and RAW capture, Portrait and Low Light modes.
apps.versionDescription:
- New: a What's new popup appears the first time you open the app after installing or updating. Its arrow opens the full changelog (changelog.json).
- New: self-timer button in the top bar. Tap once for 3 s, twice for 5 s, three times for 10 s, a fourth time for off. Tap the shutter during the countdown to cancel.
- New: smooth flip animation when you switch cameras.
- Fixed: front camera photos taken with APPLE on are now saved mirrored when Mirror is on.
- Changed: Low Light sound is now a soft tick at the start and a quick double tick when finished, instead of the long ambient tone.
- Changed: builds no longer run on every push. Start one yourself from the Actions tab with Run workflow.
- Changed: the changelog is now changelog.json (bundled in the app). The unused esign.json source file is removed; source.json is the only source file.
